versions.changelog:
Initial release of auth0-android skill

- Provides setup and integration instructions for Auth0 authentication in native Android (Kotlin/Java) apps.
- Covers Web Auth, credential storage (including biometrics), logout, callback URL setup, and common build issues.
- Guides users to check for existing UI handlers before adding new login/logout buttons.
- Includes build verification workflow and troubleshooting for common integration errors.
- Specifies when not to use this skill, redirecting to other platform-specific Auth0 solutions as appropriate.
